name: shisa-de-1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 2)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 25.806 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-21. Caveats: a decision model (next-token distribution restricted to option letters), so it is ranked on the Decision Index and excluded from the worth-running text ranking. The card prints 29 suites; 3 net wins over the Gemma 4 base are recorded and several net losses are NOT (kev-decision-v1 0.7423 vs 0.7552, compaction, ja-indirect, jdb-probe-counting). Card notes Shisa DE-2 supersedes this. Percent conversion from the card's 0-1 values is stated per row. Scores are position-sensitive: reversal shifts mean absolute 0.029.
